newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KKB negotiating Bakun contracts - paper.
newsitem.headline: KKB negotiating Bakun contracts - paper.

text.p: KKB Engineering Bhd said it was negotiating for contracts linked to the Bakun dam project in Sarawak state, the New Straits Times said on Wednesday.
It quoted group managing director of the engineering concern, Kho Kak Beng, as saying one of the contracts being negotiated was to fabricate steel structures.
KKB shares have been suspended from September 20 pending an announcement, though Kho declined to say if the suspension was related to the Bakun negotiations.
The stock was last traded at 17.10 ringgit.
